checks.title: Shutdown dialog frosted backdrop text contrast (WCAG 1.4.3)
checks.environment: Playwright Chromium WCAGate shutdown-dialog scenario in the Markdown Desktop review fixture, with dark and light color schemes
checks.evidence: WCAGate Playwright Chromium rendered the shutdown-dialog route in dark and light color schemes after the shutdown request. The dialog uses a solid panel under #shutdown-description; the foreground/background token pairs are #e8e4dc on #1a1b1d (13.59:1) and #2b2b29 on #fcfbf7 (13.70:1), calculated with the WCAG 2.x relative-luminance contrast formula. Both exceed the 4.5:1 AA normal-text threshold. The translucent backdrop is outside the dialog text surface and is retained for the modal interaction.
checks.notes: axe/color-contrast remains a cantTell only because the modal backdrop uses rgba() plus backdrop-filter. The bounded suppression in wcagate.config.mjs targets the recorded shutdown-dialog fingerprint and the cantTell outcome only; actual failed contrast findings remain release-blocking.
checks.remediation: Re-run the WCAGate shutdown-dialog scenario and repeat the contrast sampler before the evidence expiry date or after changes to modal tokens/backdrop styling.
